description: §7.2.2 rule 9: `if (…) { … }⏎-1;` — the `-1;` is a statement with no effect (E-STMT-NO-EFFECT), no longer read silently.
rationale: user-voice-scrml.md S469 "⭐ RULED — statement termination follow-ups, §7.2.2" item 4 ("Build both"): "It applies to a pure expression statement on either line, including after a block-like `}`."
